evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Human teams routinely adapt this way, while existing AI agent teams rely on fixed protocols, explicit task decomposition, or routing.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Across five mathematics and physics benchmarks, self-organizing teams average 66.7% accuracy, versus 48.8% for their strongest member, 58.7% for compute-matched inference by that agent, and 59.0% for a perfect router over members' independent answers; on AIME 2026, they exceed this router by 13.4 points.
